title: The end of a roll
body: In the last three frames of a roll (10–12, 22–24 or 34–36) the counter beside the shutter turns amber and pulses after each shot. There's a light click on entering the last three frames and a firmer one on the last. On the last frame the line under the number reads **LAST FRAME**, and the film advance runs slower, as if the film were getting tight. Nothing blocks shooting.

When the last frame is taken, the strip winds back into the film's own canister, the canister turns and settles, and **Roll complete** fades in with the Develop button. It plays once per roll, and a tap skips it.
